titulo: Four dead as Isaias weakens to post-tropical cyclone after striking Florida panhandle
cuerpo: Some of deaths came from falling trees as half a million people without power and rain and flooding still a concern At least four people were reported dead on Saturday amid Isaias after it made landfall late on Friday on Florida’s panhandle as a category 2 hurricane, according to authorities. The storm also took down trees, knocked out electricity for hundreds of thousands and flooded highways – but as Saturday evening approached, the region was reopening. Continue reading...
